title: Sneaking out of the hot spring

cues.text: You four stand beside a rock.
Yukari and Fuuka see you four. You freeze.
You lead the others into the steam. Fuuka wades up to the rock, peering toward you.
Ahead, Mitsuru and Aigis stand with backs turned.
All four of you dash for the exit.
You hurl Junpei's rubber duck across the bath.
Mitsuru and Aigis walk over toward the splash.
